_comment: 1901 Union Stock Yards special (Vol _015). VOLUME-SCOPED. Seeded from attested renames in aliases-sanborn01790_021.json (same South Side area): 39TH->PERSHING (1923 rename), CENTRE->RACINE. 43D/42D are period ordinal spellings, not renames.
_comment2: The yards' INTERNAL private streets (Broadway/Exchange, Texas Av, Dexter Park Av, Packers Av, PRIVATE ST NO. n, Cook) were demolished with the yards (closed 1971) and have NO modern centerline - those labels are unmatchable by design; sheets relying on them need the rescue pass anchored on perimeter streets (Halsted, 47th, Ashland, Pershing, 43rd).
